$matchId..read:
auth != null && (
          data.child('player1/uid').val() == auth.uid ||
          data.child('player2/uid').val() == auth.uid
        )
$matchId..write:
auth != null && (
          data.child('player1/uid').val() == auth.uid ||
          data.child('player2/uid').val() == auth.uid ||
          !data.exists()
        )

$messageId..write:
auth != null && (
              !data.exists() && newData.child('senderId').val() == auth.uid ||
              data.exists() && newData.child('read').val() == true
            )
